source.inspection: Source files extracted to temporary directory; no package scripts executed or private configuration copied

verifiedContracts.finding: Guest login stores token/user and synchronizes window.Aigram.telegramId/isInAigram. Client identity is a live UI/transport value, not proof accepted by a separate Worker.
Guest API requests attach Authorization Bearer to configured platform API or proxy.
Platform callAPI uses host transport; native/Mini App host attaches authentication.
get/data/list returns six most recent users saves, then filters mine in client. Not private credential storage and not guaranteed recovery for users outside latest six.
resolveVerifiedActor still requires existing backend login verification; browser-supplied user ID must not be trusted.

enablePlatformAigramIdentity reads telegram_id from URL and assigns A.telegramId when absent; this compatibility mirror does not add a server-verifiable assertion. Platform host callAPI authentication is a separate transport.

decision: Do not upload original/creator bearer capabilities to shared platform save data. Preserve existing authority and saves. Use a verified backend actor adapter or a documented owner-private recovery endpoint when available.
remainingContract: Authenticated host-to-game-Worker identity transport or server-side platform token verification. A new platform save system is not requested.

colleagueClarification.decision: Keep game Worker as the sole authoritative save backend, as advised. Do not request a new shared save service. Use guest-shell live telegramId for frontend account identification.
